process_notes: MGT-6 and BEN-2 are different returns; this framework requires form-specific subrules before activation.

process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Approved institutions subject to donation reporting; select old/new law by reporting period.
deadline_text: Resolve the period-specific due date and transition before scheduling.

documents: Donor identification; donation date, amount and mode; approval particulars; certificate records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: FSS licensing regulations; FoSCoS annual-return directions

compliance_name: FSSAI annual return — applicable manufacturers and importers
documents: Licence particulars; production/import quantities; product and sales data
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Food businesses changing particulars relevant to their registration/licence.

documents: Existing certificate; changed business/product details; supporting premises or entity documents
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: FSS food recall framework and applicable licence conditions
applicability_text: Affected food businesses when food requires recall or regulator directs action.
deadline_text: Incident/order-specific; do not substitute a routine annual deadline.
compliance_name: FSSAI food recall and traceability response
documents: Product and batch records; distribution traceability; recall action and effectiveness records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Plastic Waste Management Rules and EPR guidelines

deadline_text: Registration and period-specific targets/returns; validate current schedule and extensions.
exceptions_text: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

process_notes: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

governing_law: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 as amended

exceptions_text: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.
documents: Entity and product details; battery chemistry/quantities; recycling facility and consent records
process_notes: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

applicability_text: Covered electrical/electronic equipment actors; confirm schedule, role and exemptions.
deadline_text: Registration and period-specific targets/returns; validate current schedule and extensions.
exceptions_text: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.
documents: Scheduled equipment category; quantity placed on market; entity and recycler records
process_notes: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

governing_law: Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules; tyre EPR amendments
applicability_text: Covered tyre producers/importers and registered recyclers.
deadline_text: Registration and period-specific targets/returns; validate current schedule and extensions.
exceptions_text: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.
compliance_name: Waste tyre EPR fulfilment and certificates
documents: Quantity and invoices; bill of lading where relevant; recycling output and certificate records
process_notes: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

governing_law: Hazardous and Other Wastes Second Amendment Rules 2023
applicability_text: Covered base/lubrication oil producers/importers and used-oil actors; verify definitions.
deadline_text: Registration and period-specific targets/returns; validate current schedule and extensions.
exceptions_text: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.
documents: Oil category and quantities; entity particulars; relevant processing/consent records
process_notes: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

governing_law: Applicable construction and demolition waste rules
applicability_text: Covered producers, recyclers and other stakeholders; identify effective rules and project thresholds.
deadline_text: Registration and period-specific targets/returns; validate current schedule and extensions.
exceptions_text: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.
compliance_name: Construction and demolition waste registration / EPR
documents: Project and waste quantities; recycler particulars; utilisation and certificate records
process_notes: Common CPCB EPR SSO: https://epr.cpcb.gov.in/. Online registration is not proof of no facility inspection; quantitative targets remain unresolved.

applicability_text: Projects/expansions listed in applicable EIA schedule; assess capacity, location and category.
deadline_text: Obtain required prior clearance before prohibited project activity.
documents: Project report; site/location maps; prescribed application; environmental studies as required
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Applicable forest conservation legislation and rules
applicability_text: Use/diversion of covered forest land for non-forest purpose.
deadline_text: Prior approval before covered diversion; stage and conditions depend on proposal.
documents: Land records; maps; diversion proposal; compensatory afforestation information
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Projects in regulated coastal or protected/wildlife-sensitive locations.
deadline_text: Prior project approval where required; exact authority depends on location.
documents: Location and boundary maps; project details; studies and clearance records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: CGWA guidelines / applicable state groundwater legislation
applicability_text: Industrial, infrastructure or other covered groundwater abstraction; check state jurisdiction and exemptions.
deadline_text: Before covered abstraction; certificate-specific renewals and reporting.
exceptions_text: CGWA is not the licensing authority for every state; do not use one universal national application.
documents: Water requirement and source; borewell/site details; water balance; applicable studies
process_notes: CGWA is not the licensing authority for every state; do not use one universal national application.

governing_law: Customs Act and applicable import regulations
applicability_text: Importers of goods subject to customs entry and commodity-specific controls.
deadline_text: Consignment/event-specific bill-of-entry and duty rules.
compliance_name: Customs import declaration and supporting documents
documents: Commercial invoice; packing list; transport document; origin and product permissions as applicable
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Exporters of goods; special schemes and restricted products need additional controls.
deadline_text: Shipment-specific declaration and clearance.
compliance_name: Customs export declaration and supporting documents
documents: Invoice; packing list; shipping and scheme particulars; commodity permissions
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: FEMA and current foreign-investment reporting directions
applicability_text: Indian company issuing capital instruments covered by FDI reporting.
deadline_text: Use current RBI reporting direction and actual issue date; do not rely on incorporation date alone.
documents: Issue/allotment details; foreign remittance and KYC; valuation; professional certifications as applicable
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: FEMA and current foreign-investment reporting directions
applicability_text: Transfers falling within FC-TRS reporting; determine responsible resident party and exemptions.
deadline_text: Event-specific receipt/remittance or transfer clock under current RBI direction.
documents: Transfer agreement; consideration and valuation; buyer/seller residency; bank and KYC records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: FEMA foreign-investment rules and reporting directions
applicability_text: Foreign capital contribution/profit-share transactions in eligible LLPs.
deadline_text: Select contribution or transfer event and current reporting period.
compliance_name: Foreign investment in LLP — LLP-I / LLP-II
documents: LLP agreement; valuation; remittance/KYC; contribution or transfer records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Eligible convertible-note issue/transfer involving non-residents; verify startup and amount conditions.
deadline_text: Transaction-specific filing under current direction.
documents: Startup eligibility; note agreement; remittance; holder and transfer details
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Persons covered as manufacturer, packer or importer of packaged commodities.
deadline_text: Within 90 days of commencing relevant activity, subject to current rule and authority.
documents: Entity and premises particulars; product/packing details; authorisation and fee
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Covered retail packages and relevant e-commerce listings; check product exemptions.
deadline_text: Before relevant sale/offer; update when product or declared particulars change.
documents: Label artwork; manufacturer/packer/importer particulars; quantity/MRP and consumer-care records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Legal Metrology Act and applicable rules
applicability_text: Manufacture/import or trade use of covered weighing/measuring instruments.
deadline_text: Model approval and periodic stamping/verification are different events; state intervals apply.
exceptions_text: Instrument examination/testing can require physical activity even if booking/payment is online.
compliance_name: Weighing / measuring instrument model approval and verification
documents: Model specifications; test reports where required; instrument and previous verification certificate
process_notes: Instrument examination/testing can require physical activity even if booking/payment is online.

governing_law: BIS Act; applicable product Quality Control Order
applicability_text: Manufacturers/importers of products with an effective compulsory QCO; verify product, standard, exemptions and commencement.
deadline_text: Certification before regulated manufacture/import/sale; scheme-specific renewal or surveillance.
exceptions_text: Products outside compulsory orders may have voluntary certification; do not make BIS universal.
documents: Applicable IS standard; product and factory data; test reports and quality controls
process_notes: Products outside compulsory orders may have voluntary certification; do not make BIS universal.

governing_law: Applicable BIS certification scheme and licence conditions
applicability_text: BIS licensees where the applicable scheme prescribes tests or factory surveillance.
deadline_text: Use scheme/licence testing plan and surveillance events.
documents: Test and production records; licence; quality-control records; samples as required
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Drugs and Cosmetics Act and applicable rules
applicability_text: Drug activities; central/state licensing allocation differs by activity and product.
deadline_text: Prior applicable licence; certificate-specific retention/renewal duties.
exceptions_text: CDSCO SUGAM covers specified central applications; state sale/manufacture licensing must be separately resolved.
compliance_name: Drug import / manufacture / sale permission assessment
documents: Product and premises dossier; technical staff qualifications; test/manufacturing records as relevant
process_notes: CDSCO SUGAM covers specified central applications; state sale/manufacture licensing must be separately resolved.

applicability_text: Manufacturers/importers/sellers of regulated devices; distinguish risk classes and exemptions.
deadline_text: Before covered activity; current retention fee and licence conditions.
compliance_name: Medical-device licensing by risk class and activity
documents: Device classification; technical dossier; quality-system and facility evidence
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Imports of cosmetics covered by registration rules.
deadline_text: Before import; registration and retention obligations as applicable.
documents: Manufacturer authorisation; product, label and ingredient particulars; certificates as required
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Storage, transport or installation falling within licensed class/quantity; exemptions require exact facts.
deadline_text: Prior approval/licence and certificate-specific renewal.
exceptions_text: PESO FAQ routes applications via NSWS/PESO; physical site examination and certificates depend on licence class.
documents: Site/layout plans; storage class/capacity; safety and competent-person records; district NOC where required
process_notes: PESO FAQ routes applications via NSWS/PESO; physical site examination and certificates depend on licence class.

governing_law: IT Act section 70B; CERT-In directions 28 April 2022
applicability_text: Service providers, intermediaries, data centres, bodies corporate and government organisations within directions.
deadline_text: Specified incidents: within six hours of noticing or being brought to notice.
documents: Incident time/type; affected systems; available indicators; response contact and subsequent details
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Entities within directions; distinguish special customer-record duties by provider class.
deadline_text: Maintain ICT logs for rolling 180 days securely within India; designate contact as directed.
compliance_name: CERT-In ICT log retention / point of contact
documents: System logs; time synchronisation evidence; designated contact details
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023; Rules 2025 and commencement notifications
applicability_text: Digital personal-data processing within statutory scope, subject to exclusions and phased commencement.
deadline_text: Evaluate each provision on its notified effective date; no blanket current activation of all duties.
exceptions_text: This is a transition review, not a finding that all DPDP duties are already in force.
documents: Data inventory; processing purposes; notices/consent records where operative; processor arrangements
process_notes: This is a transition review, not a finding that all DPDP duties are already in force.

governing_law: Motor Vehicles Act and applicable central/state rules
applicability_text: Commercial/transport use requiring relevant goods/passenger permit; exceptions and area limits apply.
deadline_text: Before covered use and before actual permit expiry.
documents: Vehicle registration; insurance; tax and fitness particulars; route/use details
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Motor Vehicles Act and fitness rules
applicability_text: Covered transport vehicles; age/class and current testing-centre rules determine periodicity.
deadline_text: Use actual certificate expiry and applicable testing interval.
exceptions_text: Online application/payment is only part of fitness certification; vehicle testing is a physical step. Applicant personal attendance is a separate question.
documents: Registration; prior fitness; vehicle and application particulars
process_notes: Online application/payment is only part of fitness certification; vehicle testing is a physical step. Applicant personal attendance is a separate question.

governing_law: Applicable DoT/WPC spectrum and equipment requirements
applicability_text: Qualifying wireless equipment in licence-exempt bands; self-declaration only for eligible finished-product categories.
deadline_text: Before regulated import/use/sale as applicable to product.
exceptions_text: Do not equate licence-exempt spectrum with equipment-approval exemption.
documents: RF test report; product specifications; applicant/importer authorisation
process_notes: Do not equate licence-exempt spectrum with equipment-approval exemption.

applicability_text: Providing regulated telecom services or possessing/using radio equipment outside relevant exemptions.
deadline_text: Before covered service/activity; check current authorisation category and transition.
documents: Entity particulars; proposed service/spectrum/equipment details; technical documents
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

exceptions_text: Government implementation source establishes CROP system; exact current checklist not independently checked.

process_notes: Government implementation source establishes CROP system; exact current checklist not independently checked.

process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

process_notes: State controlling authority grants licence; antecedent checks and training arrangements are separate from uploading application.

process_notes: Source is Kerala-specific; its interpretation is not asserted as a verified rule for every state.

process_notes: A commencement announcement alone does not verify every threshold or state procedural rule.

applicability_text: Covered shops and establishments in the UT.

deadline_text: Apply using current service procedure; Rule 27 framework in N028.

governing_law: Meghalaya excise legislation and current policy

documents: Applicant/entity; premises and activity particulars; current excise checklist required
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

deadline_text: Before covered advertising/marketing/booking/sale; check project status and exemptions.
documents: Project/title/approval particulars; promoter and financial information; current authority checklist
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Delhi municipal legislation and MCD GTL procedure

deadline_text: Before covered trade; renewal/amendment according to current certificate and SOP.

governing_law: Tamil Nadu urban local-body framework and GCC trade procedure
applicability_text: Covered trades in GCC jurisdiction; small-premises service class has its own conditions.

documents: Applicant identity; premises rental agreement/property-tax receipt; photographs; further category-specific documents may be requested
process_notes: Published SOP allows online and assisted/office routes. Historic checklists should be checked against current service class.

governing_law: FEMA and RBI annual FLA reporting requirements
applicability_text: Entities covered by RBI FLA FAQ, including eligible companies/LLPs with outstanding inward/outward direct investment at year end; distinguish special AIF procedure.
deadline_text: 15 July of reporting year. Provisional figures may be used; obtain FLAIR permission to revise as described in current FAQ.
compliance_name: Annual foreign liabilities and assets return
documents: Financial statements; investment/shareholding data; FLAIR verification and authority letters for registration
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules 9A/9B
applicability_text: Companies covered by applicable dematerialisation rules; assess unlisted public/private class, exclusions, relevant financial-year status and transition.
deadline_text: Within 60 days of each applicable half-year end; verify period-specific relaxations.
exceptions_text: Do not activate from current turnover alone. Rule 9B transition and changed small-company status need separate legal review.
documents: ISIN and depository balances; issued/listed/physical/demat capital reconciliation; professional certification
process_notes: Do not activate from current turnover alone. Rule 9B transition and changed small-company status need separate legal review.

governing_law: Companies Act section 64; Share Capital and Debentures Rules
applicability_text: Applicable capital alteration, increase/consolidation/division or specified redemption events; purpose controls attachments.
deadline_text: Section 64 ordinarily requires notice within 30 days of alteration/increase/redemption; evaluate exact event.
compliance_name: Notice of alteration of share capital
documents: Resolution; altered memorandum/articles where relevant; capital breakdown; tribunal order where applicable
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Companies Act section 140(2); Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, rule 8
applicability_text: Resigning auditor must file; company workflow should track receipt and replacement separately.
deadline_text: Within 30 days of resignation; additional CAG communication where section 140 applies.
exceptions_text: Legal filer is the auditor, not automatically the company or its director.
documents: Resignation letter; auditor identity and membership/firm details; reasons and relevant facts
process_notes: Legal filer is the auditor, not automatically the company or its director.

governing_law: APEDA Act and current e-RCMC procedure
applicability_text: Exporters of APEDA scheduled agricultural/processed-food products; distinguish merchant and manufacturer category.
deadline_text: Obtain applicable registration for scheduled-product export; certificate validity is five years under current procedure. Confirm exact initial statutory clock.
documents: Signed/sealed IEC; product-specific manufacturing evidence for manufacturer or combined category
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: NITI Aayog Darpan requirements; applicable grant, FCRA and PML records framework
applicability_text: NPOs needing Darpan ID for central grants, relevant FCRA/tax applications or bank account requirements. Separate bank duty from NPO application prerequisites.
deadline_text: Before the relevant application/account process requires the ID; keep registration particulars current.
